title: ui-kit shell layout
description: One fixed app-shell layout: the regions it uses and the grid that places them. build_layouts.py checks the rules JSON Schema cannot express: every name in areas is a listed region and every listed region appears in areas, areas is rectangular with one column per track, and each region covers one rectangle.

id.description: The layout id; equals the file name without .json and is the value of data-layout on .ui-shell.

label.description: A short human name for the layout.

regions.description: The regions this layout uses, in the order they are emitted.

areas.description: One string per row; region names separated by single spaces.

track.description: auto, Nfr or minmax(0, Nfr). Fractions only, never pixels.
